newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Wk to date - 92,300 Week Ago - 112,500 Year Ago - 71,700
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00, pen North Plains 64.50.

Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers; Week to date 92,300 which includes 34,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
